need.text: Prove an asset atom can run headless Blender on the CPU inside its isolate, read a GLB from a read-only bind of a hydrated worktree, and hand a report to compose.

acceptance.statement: The composed report names the bollard GLB and at least one imported object.

check.run: python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(open('/in/compose/report.json')); sys.exit(0 if d['glb'].endswith('set_bollard.glb') and d['objects']>0 else 1)"

atoms.title: Import a set GLB in headless Blender
atoms.contract: Import set_bollard.glb from the read-only bind with Blender on the CPU and write report.json with the GLB path and the number of imported objects.

command: import bpy,json; p='/assets/set-glb/set_bollard.glb'; bpy.ops.import_scene.gltf(filepath=p); json.dump({'glb': p, 'objects': len(bpy.data.objects), 'blender': bpy.app.version_string}, open('/out/report.json','w'))

atoms.title: Pass the report through
atoms.contract: Copy the probe's report.json to the output unchanged so acceptance can check it.
